diagnostics.bins: training quartiles at .25/.5/.75, open outer bins, right-closed, repeated edges merged
diagnostics.case_order: FP by highest P(AI), FN by lowest P(AI), ties by ID

measures.punct_per_char: characters that are not alphanumeric or whitespace / characters, 0 when empty
measures.upper_per_letter: uppercase letters / letters, 0 when no letters

internal.how: train_test_split(test_size=.2, stratify=label, random_state=42) on manifest training order, then sorted indices (#15)

nb_transfer.classifier: LR C1 liblinear max_iter 3000 tol 1e-4 seed 42
nb_transfer.features: normalized text; binary CountVectorizer word1-3 max 120000 + char3-5 max 180000, min_df 2, float32
nb_transfer.normalization: NFKC; canonical quotes/dashes/ellipsis; remove Cf; collapse whitespace; lowercase
nb_transfer.ratio: NB log ratio alpha 1 on verified + assigned pseudo labels
nb_transfer.teacher: original #13 HistGB (no copies) on the same fit rows

old_soft.flag: literal two consecutive newlines; active only when zero human fit rows have it
old_soft.score: mean of standardized margins + active flag*2; outer standardization on eligible unlabeled
old_soft.specialist: case char2-5 SVM C1, fit rows without literal blank line
old_soft.specialist_reference: eligible unlabeled rows without literal blank lines
old_soft.word: word1-3 + case char2-5 LR C16, all fit rows

config.reproduction: same grid with original #13 style arm, compared to #15 internal and validation numbers; not used for selection
config.score_mapping: sigmoid of weighted standardized scores; calibration measured, not assumed
config.selection: on internal 1600: eligible if remove_blank and collapse each >= pure augmented hist - .002; max original AUROC; grid order breaks exact ties (pure hist first); wrap80 measured only; saved before validation

stress_definitions.wrap80: split on blank lines, textwrap.fill width 80, break_long_words=False, break_on_hyphens=False, join with blank line (#14)

config.threads: threadpool_limits(limits=1) for every fit and score
